about: Every line, who says it, the fact tags it rests on (FACTS.md), and the take used in the cut. text is exactly what was sent to ElevenLabs (numbers spelled out, delivery tag first).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [curious] On August first, 2012, Knight Capital lost more than four hundred and sixty million dollars... in about forty-five minutes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [curious] One technician had to copy new code onto eight servers, and missed one. On that one, old code called Power Peg was still there. From eight-oh-one, the system sent ninety-seven emails. Power Peg disabled.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [curious] It wasn't. At nine thirty, the market opened, and it woke up. Two hundred and twelve small orders in. Over four million trades out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [curious] So how does one missed server cost more than four hundred and sixty million dollars?
